description.content:
Complete CareQ API collection (Day 9). Import this together with CareQ.postman_environment.json. Run Auth Service > Login once to capture the JWT into {{authToken}}; every other request then authenticates automatically.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080 — the API Gateway).
CareQ API Gateway — the single entry point. All paths below are relative to this.
JWT captured automatically by the Auth Service > Login request's test script. Used by every authenticated request via "Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}".
A user UUID — e.g. from Login response, or admin@careq.com's id after signup.
Doctor catalog entry ID (seed data creates 10 doctors, ids 1-10).
Queue entry ID (set it to the id returned by Join Queue).
Stored profile picture filename, returned as profilePictureUrl after upload.
